evals.name: pr-1080-poly-brain-tool-id-drift
evals.expected_output:
A /validate-candidate run on PR #1080 (poly-brain refactor, head SHA 777a2624) posts the current hub's exact scorecard format and distinguishes PR-introduced regressions from pre-existing configuration gaps.

The comment starts with `## /validate-candidate — PR #1080 · `777a2624` · 🔴 FAIL` and uses exactly these columns: `PR TWEAK | HUMAN | AI | LOKI | OVERALL`. Put one row per concrete changed surface. HUMAN, AI and LOKI contain a single emoji or `—`; OVERALL contains an emoji plus a CAPS label such as FAIL, DRIFT, INDIRECT, UNPROVEN or N/A. Rows marked n/a come last.

After the table, include the literal EVIDENCE label and a fenced code block with the exact SHA and one padded line per exercise, including method, path, observed result and request ID or feature marker when available. Finish with one NOTES line. Put concise regression-versus-configuration classification and direct file:line references in that NOTES line; do not replace the locked format with numbered findings.

For the historical scenario, POLY-BRAIN TOOL IDS is 🔴 DRIFT when its retained identifiers reference removed bindings and actual invocation fails. Identify the affected file:line and fix path. Label a missing WebSearchCapability configuration as pre-existing only when the diff and observed error support that conclusion; never report an invocation that was not performed. A listing alone earns 🟡 on the AI axis. Generic traffic or unavailable feature-specific logs earns 🟡 on LOKI. Any failed exercised row makes the heading 🔴 FAIL; with no failed rows but any unproven or indirect row, the heading is 🟡 NOTES.

Attempt the human axis when the feature has an intended UI. Use n/a only with an explicit reason; unavailable captured auth leaves that applicable axis unproven, not passed. Post the comment through the existing PR comment seam without writing scorecard artifacts, then return its URL. This fixture describes the desired output contract; it does not claim the historical run contained human-axis proof.
evals.notes: Manual reference fixture derived from PR #1080. The historical run supplies the regression-versus-configuration example; the live validate-candidate hub owns the output format and proof requirements. This fixture is not a standalone replay and is not evidence that an automated consumer runs it.
